from manim import *

class SafeNumberlineSearchWindow(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("The search window gets smaller", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 12, 1], length=8.5, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 0.25)
        target = Dot(line.n2p(7), color=GREEN_D, radius=0.09)
        target_label = MathTex("7", font_size=30, color=GREEN_D).next_to(target, UP)

        def window(left, right, color):
            width = abs(line.n2p(right)[0] - line.n2p(left)[0])
            band = Rectangle(width=width, height=0.42, stroke_color=color, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.18)
            return band.move_to((line.n2p(left) + line.n2p(right)) / 2)

        wide = window(0, 12, BLUE_D)
        middle = window(4, 9, TEAL_D)
        narrow = window(6, 8, GREEN_D)
        mid_a = Dot(line.n2p(6), color=YELLOW_D)
        mid_b = Dot(line.n2p(8), color=YELLOW_D)
        caption_a = Text("Start with the whole sorted range.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("Each comparison removes half the candidates.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_c = Text("The remaining window isolates the target.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(wide), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(mid_a), ReplacementTransform(wide, middle), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(mid_b), ReplacementTransform(middle, narrow), FadeIn(target), FadeIn(target_label), ReplacementTransform(caption_b, caption_c), run_time=5)
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

class SafeConfidenceIntervalRectangles(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Intervals show uncertainty", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 10, 1], length=8.2, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 0.55)
        estimate = Dot(line.n2p(5), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.09)
        estimate_label = Text("estimate", font_size=24, color=YELLOW_D).next_to(estimate, UP, buff=0.28)

        def interval(left, right, color):
            width = abs(line.n2p(right)[0] - line.n2p(left)[0])
            band = Rectangle(width=width, height=0.38, stroke_color=color, fill_color=color, fill_opacity=0.2)
            return band.move_to((line.n2p(left) + line.n2p(right)) / 2)

        narrow = interval(4.4, 5.6, TEAL_D)
        wide = interval(3.2, 6.8, BLUE_D)
        narrow_brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(4.4), line.n2p(5.6), direction=DOWN, color=TEAL_D)
        wide_brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(3.2), line.n2p(6.8), direction=DOWN, color=BLUE_D)
        narrow_label = Text("narrow", font_size=24, color=TEAL_D).next_to(narrow_brace, DOWN)
        wide_label = Text("wide = more uncertainty", font_size=24, color=BLUE_B).next_to(wide_brace, DOWN)
        caption = Text("The estimate stays fixed while uncertainty changes.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(estimate), FadeIn(estimate_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(narrow), GrowFromCenter(narrow_brace), FadeIn(narrow_label), run_time=3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(narrow, wide), ReplacementTransform(narrow_brace, wide_brace), ReplacementTransform(narrow_label, wide_label), run_time=4)
        self.play(FadeIn(caption), run_time=2)
        self.wait(3)

prompt: Create a 15-second Manim scene that explains three fourths on the unit interval. Show a number line from 0 to 1, four equal segments, braces under the first three segments, and a short takeaway caption.

from manim import *

class SafeFractionFourthsBraces(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Three fourths means three equal parts", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[0, 1, 0.25], length=7.2, include_numbers=False, include_ticks=True)
        line.shift(UP * 0.45)
        labels = VGroup(MathTex("0", font_size=28), MathTex("1", font_size=28))
        labels[0].next_to(line.n2p(0), DOWN, buff=0.22)
        labels[1].next_to(line.n2p(1), DOWN, buff=0.22)
        thirds = VGroup(
            Line(line.n2p(0), line.n2p(0.25), color=YELLOW_D, stroke_width=8),
            Line(line.n2p(0.25), line.n2p(0.5), color=YELLOW_D, stroke_width=8),
            Line(line.n2p(0.5), line.n2p(0.75), color=YELLOW_D, stroke_width=8),
        )
        braces = VGroup(*[BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(a), line.n2p(b), direction=DOWN, color=YELLOW_D) for a, b in [(0, 0.25), (0.25, 0.5), (0.5, 0.75)]])
        dot = Dot(line.n2p(0.75), color=GREEN_D, radius=0.09)
        fraction = MathTex(r"\frac{3}{4}", font_size=42, color=GREEN_D).next_to(dot, UP)
        caption = Text("Count three of the four equal pieces of one whole.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(labels), run_time=3)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[Create(part) for part in thirds], lag_ratio=0.2), run_time=3)
        self.play(LaggedStart(*[GrowFromCenter(brace) for brace in braces], lag_ratio=0.15), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(dot), FadeIn(fraction), FadeIn(caption), run_time=3)
        self.wait(3)

from manim import *

class SafeMobjectSurroundingRectangle(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Highlight boxes wrap objects", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        card_a = VGroup(RoundedRectangle(width=2.2, height=1.2, corner_radius=0.12, color=BLUE_D), Text("step 1", font_size=28))
        card_b = VGroup(RoundedRectangle(width=2.2, height=1.2, corner_radius=0.12, color=TEAL_D), Text("step 2", font_size=28))
        cards = VGroup(card_a, card_b).arrange(RIGHT, buff=1.1).shift(UP * 0.1)
        box_a = SurroundingRectangle(card_a, color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.12)
        box_b = SurroundingRectangle(card_b, color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.12)
        arrow = Arrow(card_a.get_right(), card_b.get_left(), buff=0.22, color=GRAY_B)
        caption_a = Text("The rectangle receives a Mobject, not a raw coordinate.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)
        caption_b = Text("Transform the box when attention moves.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(cards), GrowArrow(arrow), run_time=3)
        self.play(Create(box_a), FadeIn(caption_a), run_time=3)
        self.play(ReplacementTransform(box_a, box_b), ReplacementTransform(caption_a, caption_b), run_time=4)
        self.wait(5)

from manim import *

class SafeAttentionWeightCopy(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Attention copies the strongest signal", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        weights = Matrix([["0.10", "0.75", "0.15"]]).scale(0.7).shift(UP * 1.15)
        values = VGroup(*[Matrix([[name], [word]]).scale(0.55) for name, word in [("v_1", "red"), ("v_2", "round"), ("v_3", "sweet")]])
        values.arrange(RIGHT, buff=0.72).shift(DOWN * 0.4)
        strong_box = SurroundingRectangle(weights.get_columns()[1], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.08)
        value_box = SurroundingRectangle(values[1], color=YELLOW_D, buff=0.1)
        output = VGroup(RoundedRectangle(width=1.8, height=0.8, corner_radius=0.1, color=GREEN_D, fill_color=GREEN_E, fill_opacity=0.22), MathTex("out", font_size=34, color=GREEN_D)).arrange()
        output.to_edge(RIGHT, buff=0.8).shift(UP * 0.1)
        arrow = Arrow(values[1].get_right(), output.get_left(), buff=0.18, color=GREEN_D)
        legend = Text("larger weight means more influence", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), FadeIn(weights), run_time=3)
        self.play(FadeIn(values), Create(strong_box), Create(value_box), run_time=3)
        self.play(TransformFromCopy(values[1], output), GrowArrow(arrow), FadeIn(legend), run_time=4)
        self.wait(5)

class SafeNumberlineTickLabels(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        title = Text("Read position from the line", font_size=32).to_edge(UP)
        line = NumberLine(x_range=[-2, 6, 1], length=8, include_numbers=True).shift(UP * 0.35)
        dot = Dot(line.n2p(-1), color=YELLOW_D, radius=0.09)
        end_dot = Dot(line.n2p(4), color=GREEN_D, radius=0.09)
        path = Line(line.n2p(-1), line.n2p(4), color=GREEN_D, stroke_width=6)
        brace = BraceBetweenPoints(line.n2p(-1), line.n2p(4), direction=DOWN, color=GREEN_D)
        label = MathTex(r"5\ units", font_size=34, color=GREEN_D).next_to(brace, DOWN)
        caption = Text("Use the built-in numbers; avoid custom tick kwargs.", font_size=23).to_edge(DOWN)

        self.play(FadeIn(title), Create(line), FadeIn(dot), run_time=2)
        self.play(Create(path), dot.animate.move_to(end_dot), FadeIn(end_dot), run_time=4)
        self.play(GrowFromCenter(brace), FadeIn(label), FadeIn(caption), run_time=3)
        self.wait(3)
